query: SELECT sd.dependency_host_id AS "dependency_host_id!", sd.schedule_id AS "schedule_id!", sd.agent_id AS "agent_id!" FROM schedule_dependencies sd UNION SELECT ad.dependency_host_id, st.schedule_id, st.agent_id FROM agent_default_dependencies ad JOIN schedule_targets st ON st.agent_id = ad.agent_id UNION SELECT rd.dependency_host_id, st.schedule_id, st.agent_id FROM repo_host_dependencies rd JOIN repos r ON r.repo_host_id = rd.repo_host_id JOIN schedule_repos sr ON sr.repo_id = r.id JOIN schedule_targets st ON st.schedule_id = sr.schedule_id ORDER BY 1, 2, 3
